policy.same_continent: Use a known flight path when it saves time; otherwise follow roads and zone connections.
policy.resumption: Every travel instruction is optional because a resumed character may already be at the destination or have a better known route.
policy.hearth: Do not prescribe a bind or hearth use without knowing the character's bind point and cooldown.

links.instruction: Take the ship between Auberdine and Menethil Harbor
Take the ship between Ratchet and Booty Bay
Take the ship between Auberdine and Valnaar's Berth outside the Exodar
Cross the Dark Portal between the Blasted Lands and Hellfire Peninsula
Use the Alliance capital portal closest to the next route zone
